parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the OceanBase cluster.

parameters.name: TenantId
parameters.description: The ID of the tenant. If you specify the ID of a tenant in MySQL mode, the privilege configuration of the regular user in MySQL mode is returned. If you specify the ID of a tenant in Oracle mode, the privilege configuration of the regular user in Oracle mode is returned.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oceanbasepro describe-tenant-user-roles --tenant-id t4pnum0000 --instance-id ob317v4uif0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun oceanbasepro DescribeTenantUserRoles --region cn-hangzhou --TenantId t4pnum0000 --InstanceId ob317v4uif0000
